title: Guided API first-run storyboard & annotated screenshot assets
text:
Guided API first-run storyboard & annotated screenshot assets

description:
Create a compact, annotated storyboard and a set of final screenshots for the Hosted API getting-started flow. Assets will cover: model selection (curated defaults, small explainer tooltip), request builder (preset templates, sampling controls, streaming toggle), and copy-ready code snippets (curl + JS SDK + Python). Deliverables should include responsive frames (desktop and tablet), light/dark variants, and a copy deck with suggested microcopy for tooltips and button states. These assets will replace ad-hoc screenshots in the docs and power the new quickstart carousel in the Console and docs site.

acceptance_criteria:
Figma board with annotated frames for model select, request builder, and code snippet panes
Final exported PNG/JPG screenshots (desktop/tablet) in the Drive folder, optimized for docs and marketing tiles
Copy deck with approved microcopy for tooltips, default model rationale, and error states
One consolidated screenshot set for light and dark mode with filenames matching docs naming convention
Designer QA pass completed and engineering handoff notes added to Confluence

comments:
2026-03-03 - Asha: Initial storyboard uploaded to Figma. Focused on reducing initial choices in model select and surfacing a 'Recommended for quickstart' badge.
2026-03-04 - Luis: Reviewed storyboard; suggested adding a streaming toggle and sample token-count estimation under the Request Builder.
2026-03-05 - PM Elena Kovac: Prefer UX that highlights cost/latency tradeoffs for each default model. Request: small inline explainer under model name.
2026-03-07 - Asha: Updated frames to include token estimator and a collapsed advanced settings panel. Uploaded copy deck v0.2 to Confluence link above.
2026-03-09 - Design Review: Reduce on-screen copy by 20% on the request builder, use icons + hover tooltips for sampling params. Action: produce an icon set with accessible labels.
2026-03-10 - Engineering (Ming Zhao): Confirmed ability to support streaming indicator and updated API examples in docs PR #2146. Noted: backend will expose 'estimated_cost' field by end of cycle.
2026-03-11 - Asha: Exported light/dark PNGs and added alt text suggestions in the Drive export. Uploaded compact carousel 256x144 assets.
2026-03-12 - Luis: QA pass - flagged contrast on dark small text for request builder. Action: increase font weight and re-export dark variants by 3/14. Pending localization review for copy strings.
